title: Middle node of a linked list
summary: One walker takes two carriages for every one the other takes; when the fast one reaches the end, the slow one is in the middle.
goal: Find the middle carriage, the second of two middles for an even train

mapping.formal: Node where slow stops; the list from there is returned

examples.label: Five carriages
examples.explanation: Carriage 3 is the middle; the train from there is 3, 4, 5.

examples.label: Six carriages
examples.explanation: With two middles, 3 and 4, the second is chosen.

examples.label: One carriage
examples.explanation: The only carriage is the middle.

ladder.name: Count, then walk halfway
ladder.idea: Walk the train once to count its carriages, then walk again to carriage count / 2.

ladder.name: Fast and slow walkers
ladder.idea: Start two walkers at the front. Slow moves one carriage, fast moves two. When fast cannot move on, slow is in the middle.
ladder.insight: Fast always covers twice the distance of slow, so when fast has covered the whole train, slow has covered half of it. One walk replaces the count.

transfer.problem: Split a linked list into two halves of equal length (the first half one longer if odd).
transfer.explanation: Use fast and slow pointers to find the middle in one pass, then cut the list there.

selfCheck: Moves fast two steps and slow one step per loop.
Checks both fast and fast.next before moving.
Returns the second middle for an even train.
